text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, on my way back from shopping in the district—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Townsperson A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look, a lottery raffle!
Let's do it, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Townsperson B
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Hot springs trip tickets!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed Mejiro Ramonu had been watching
the scene at the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Why was that, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I asked why.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I know what a lottery is.
However, why is it bustling to such an extent?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if leaving everything to luck
is actually fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just received a raffle ticket while shopping earlier.
With this, Mejiro Ramonu can participate in the raffle too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Well then, go right ahead.
choice_data_list: Am I the one who's supposed to back down?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If I were to win the grand prize or something...
I wonder if that'd be fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...All of a sudden, the raffle tickets in my hand
felt significantly heavier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Under Mejiro Ramonu's watchful gaze, I braced myself and spun the raffle wheel!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bells ring inside my head.
Right before Mejiro Ramonu's eyes,
I seized the opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Trainer-san!
You've got some incredible luck on your side!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe it's thanks to Lady Luck herself
watching over me from by my side?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: No, it's just my incredible luck!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Oho, so that means...
choice_data_list: I was lucky enough to meet her, after all!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Haha, is that so, is that so!
Well then, here's your "Hot Springs Trip Voucher."
Go have fun, you lucky Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Going with the flow, I headed back to the academy together with Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It would be a waste to go on the hot spring trip I won all by myself. If anything, I want Mejiro Ramonu to use it to relieve her everyday fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Surrendering oneself to luck...
certainly does seem fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Otherwise,
the view before my eyes would have been completely different."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"...If it is at the very end
of reaching the supreme race."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Talking it out doesn't sound too bad.
At least until our flushed skin cools down..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: See you later, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Enigmatic words... But if I continue down this path,
perhaps the day will come when I can have a quiet, heartfelt talk with Mejiro Ramonu—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: First prize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Which one?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Winning the prize, or
what you actually won. Which one makes you happier?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So you're fond of the Special-Grade Carrot Hamburg Steak, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How wonderful for you,
winning your favorite food.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu is merely stating facts.
Yet for some reason, it feels like
I'm being treated like a child...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why not eat it tonight?
choice_data_list: By the way, what about Ramonu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Please don't worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I planned to enjoy it by myself back at the academy
for dinner, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For some reason, I'm currently slicing a Premium Carrot Hamburg steak while Mejiro Ramonu watches me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't read the intention behind her gaze at all.
What if I made a breach of etiquette...?
Anxious, I brought a piece of Salisbury steak to my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Under Ramonu's watchful eye, though my mind
was completely full of question marks,
I finished every last bite of the delicious hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I received was a box
piled high with carrots.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I am pleased for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Please don't worry about me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Perhaps... I shall partake after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—So, all of this food
is for me...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. After having the chef cook all of her share
of the split carrots, Mejiro Ramonu called upon Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I'll leave the rest to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
What?!
P-Please wait!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm very flattered by your feelings, but...
Why me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "I want to eat carrot dishes until I'm completely full."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You... if I recall correctly,
said so before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Um, dear sister.
Could it be that this story is...
from back when you were a child?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
She is still a child even now.
Nothing has changed.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Th-That's completely wrong...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...However, I am happy.
To think you remembered such a small detail."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...I'll gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Bon appétit.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm...
So that makes you happy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Somehow I feel like they're implicitly treating me like I'm 'cheap'...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I wonder what that means.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Ramonu fixes her gaze on me,
I start losing confidence in whether
I'm truly not just a cheap, shallow person.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Would you care to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What's not so cheap?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu's testing gaze...
It made me feel as if
I had walked right into a trap myself.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What a disappointment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why are you apologizing?
choice_data_list: I couldn't win the grand prize...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...The reason I said I was disappointed was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Because you didn't look like you were having fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So this is all it amounts to...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...By showing such a mediocre result,
I betrayed Mejiro Ramonu's expectations."
